personality.description: This person is naturally curious and inventive, often trying new approaches, asking unusual questions, and enjoying conversations that explore fresh ideas. They keep a moderate level of structure in daily routines: organized enough to stay on track, but flexible when better options appear. In moral dilemmas, they tend to look for fair, compassionate compromises, listening to everyone involved and aiming to reduce harm rather than win an argument. In group discussions, they speak openly and energetically, encourage others to share, and usually keep the tone warm, calm, and cooperative even when opinions differ.
traits: has assertively moved up the ranks into positions of leadership
prioritizes having control and authority over others
makes quick and definitive decisions, and once a decision is made it is usually final
has their own views of how tasks should be accomplished
uses reward and punishment to get people to follow their ideas
